purpose: Validation-only transfer of the frozen stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 candidate to ETTm2 H96 with seven same-source baselines.
research_question: Does the fixed stride-24 AutoCon candidate retain accuracy on a second high-frequency ETT dataset without dataset-specific retuning?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix supports only ETTm2 validation and an explicit transfer boundary. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal speed, independent AutoCon causality, or universal generalization.

required_before_launch: verify ETTm2 fingerprint and exact 24-job expansion
freeze stride-24 candidate, baseline, optimizer, normalization, and seed contracts

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate, baselines, split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are fixed before launch; no held-out signal or dataset-specific retuning is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives AutoCon lambda=.001 and stride-24 patching; prediction fusion remains disabled.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: Baselines receive no AutoCon, representation fusion, ACF memory, or candidate-only setting.

phases.name: stride24_candidate_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen stride-24 MambaTSv3 relation-auxiliary-only candidate on ETTm2.

phases.name: stride24_baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-source DLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, iTransformer, Mamba-1, TimesNet, and Mamba-2 baselines on ETTm2.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report every ETTm2 paired cell, including failures; measure fixed-shape resources separately.

stopping_rules: Do not alter the frozen candidate in response to this matrix.
Do not promote ETTm2 to a held-out plan if the candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest baseline.
Do not infer AutoCon causality from candidate-versus-baseline differences.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTm2 fingerprint and exact 24-job expansion
